entities.summary: Angkorian Khmer Empire, a political institution in Laos during Tai Migrations and Muang Polities (700–1200). Grew from Early Mon-Khmer and Tai Peoples. Led to the emergence of Tai Settlement and Khmer Influence and Muang Consolidation.
